mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_QUAL_RUNNING_LOCK (DM_ID, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM, DIAG_ID, USER_ID, START_DT) VALUES ( #{dmId}, #{objNm}, #{attrNm}, #{diagId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{startDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, to_char(now(),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) ) ON CONFLICT (DM_ID, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_QUAL_RUNNING_LOCK WHERE DM_ID = #{dmId} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND ATTR_NM = #{attrNm}
DELETE FROM TB_QUAL_RUNNING_LOCK WHERE START_DT < to_char(now() - INTERVAL '30 minutes', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
mapper.select: SELECT DM_ID AS dmId, OBJ_NM AS objNm, ATTR_NM AS attrNm, DIAG_ID AS diagId, USER_ID AS userId, START_DT AS startDt FROM TB_QUAL_RUNNING_LOCK ORDER BY START_DT DESC

SELECT DM_ID AS dmId, OBJ_NM AS objNm, ATTR_NM AS attrNm, DIAG_ID AS diagId, USER_ID AS userId, START_DT AS startDt FROM TB_QUAL_RUNNING_LOCK WHERE DM_ID = #{dmId} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND ATTR_NM = #{attrNm}
